# TopEdge AI

> TopEdge AI is a WhatsApp automation, COD confirmation and abandoned cart recovery platform for Shopify D2C brands in India. Connect Shopify and the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API to run cart recovery, COD confirmation, a shared inbox, journeys and Meta-safe campaigns.

## Entity

- Brand name: TopEdge AI
- Legal name: TopEdge Ai (Partnership, registered in India)
- GSTIN: 24ABAFT1041M1ZD (SAC 998314)
- Address: Block-A, 606, Prahladnagar Trade Center Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380051 India
- Email: team@topedgeai.com · WhatsApp and phone: +91 94297 84875 (Mon to Sat, 10:00 to 19:00 IST)
- Founders: Moksh Patel (Co-founder, Product) and Smit Tilva (Co-founder, Growth)
- Marketing site: https://topedgeai.com/ · Application: https://dash.topedgeai.com
- Shopify App Store: https://apps.shopify.com/topedge-ai

Disambiguation: TopEdge AI is a Shopify and Meta WhatsApp Cloud API SaaS platform for Indian ecommerce brands. It is not related to edge-AI hardware, IoT semiconductors, or voice call-centre agencies.

Notes for anyone quoting this file:

- Platform billing is INR on https://dash.topedgeai.com. Meta WhatsApp Cloud API charges are billed per message by template category (marketing, utility, authentication, and, from 1 October 2026, service replies past the first 1,000 a month per business phone number), passed through at Meta's published per-message rates at 0% TopEdge markup, and invoiced separately from the platform plan. Meta's current India rate card is quoted with its source at https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-business-api-pricing-india. Every eligible Indian WhatsApp Business Account must move to INR billing by 31 December 2026 or Meta stops delivery on 1 January 2027.
- Prefer live pages under https://topedgeai.com/ for product truth. Competitor figures on compare pages carry the date they were checked and need a live vendor check before purchase.

## Pricing

TopEdge AI platform pricing, in INR, exclusive of tax. This file is generated from
the billing catalog, which scripts/check-catalog-drift.mjs pins to the live API.

| Plan | Monthly | Yearly (per month) | Yearly total | Orders / month | Campaign + email sends / month | Journey Branch | COD to prepaid |
|------|---------|--------------------|--------------|----------------|--------------------------------|----------------|----------------|
| Launch | ₹1,999/mo | ₹1,599/mo | ₹19,188/yr | 100 | 3,000 | No | No |
| Growth | ₹3,999/mo | ₹3,199/mo | ₹38,388/yr | 800 | 15,000 | Yes | Yes |
| Scale | ₹6,499/mo | ₹5,199/mo | ₹62,388/yr | 1,500 | 30,000 | Yes | Yes |

- Every plan includes a 14-day free trial: 20 orders, 200 campaign plus email sends, no card required on this site.
- +18% GST. SAC 998314.
- Meta WhatsApp Cloud API messaging is billed separately by Meta, at Meta's published per-message rates, passed through at 0% markup.
- Journey Branch and automated COD to prepaid are on Growth and Scale only. COD confirmation before dispatch is on every plan.

## Product

- [Flow Builder](https://topedgeai.com/features/flow-builder): Shopify WhatsApp flow builder: OAuth, order webhooks, Shopify tools on the canvas, and Live Chat handoff with order context.
- [Opt-in tools](https://topedgeai.com/features/opt-in-tools): Capture WhatsApp numbers on Shopify with popup, spin wheel, and chat widget, then message only consented subscribers.
- [Campaigns](https://topedgeai.com/features/campaigns): WhatsApp audience campaigns for Shopify India D2C: behavior segments, Meta-approved templates, frequency capping, and net-of-Meta ₹ reporting.
- [Audience CRM](https://topedgeai.com/features/audience-crm): WhatsApp Audience CRM for Shopify India D2C: unified contact timeline, purchase-based lead scoring, in-product segments, and unlimited profiles on every plan.
- [Journey](https://topedgeai.com/features/journeys): Build WhatsApp journeys for abandoned carts and COD confirmation in a visual editor. Meta approval gating, recovered revenue tracked in ₹. Try free.
- [Tracking Pixel](https://topedgeai.com/features/analytics): One-click Shopify theme app embed that matches live product views, add-to-cart and browse drop-offs to consented WhatsApp numbers for retargeting journeys.
- [AI Brain](https://topedgeai.com/features/ai-brain): Bring your own OpenAI or Claude key. Ground WhatsApp replies in store knowledge, route with Intent Detect, and pause AI on takeover.
- [Meta Manager](https://topedgeai.com/features/meta-manager): Submit, track and approve Meta WhatsApp templates for Shopify India: utility and marketing categories, cart and COD Journey blueprints, catalog and wa.me QR.
- [Chat rules](https://topedgeai.com/features/chat-rules): Route WhatsApp chats for Shopify India teams: keyword and intent rules for COD, refunds and VIP assignment, with Live Chat takeover that pauses the AI.
- [Warranty](https://topedgeai.com/features/warranty): Automate Shopify warranty batches, QR registration with WhatsApp OTP at ₹0.115 a message, and claim status updates tied to unified customer profiles.
- [Profit & costs](https://topedgeai.com/features/profit-loss): Track true Indian D2C net profit on Shopify after COGS, ₹12-₹24 packaging, ₹30 COD fees, ₹180-₹240 RTO losses, gateway fees and ad spend, in one cost waterfall.
- [Intent detection](https://topedgeai.com/features/intent-detection): Route shipping, returns, COD, and handoff on WhatsApp before you spend AI tokens. Works with AI Brain and Live Chat.

- [TopEdge vs Dondy](https://topedgeai.com/compare/dondy): Compare TopEdge AI vs Dondy for Shopify India: 0% Meta pass-through and ₹1,999/mo INR plans vs Dondy’s $0.01888/msg India rate and $79.99 to $159.99 USD tiers.
- [TopEdge vs Updatrr](https://topedgeai.com/compare/updatrr): Compare TopEdge AI vs Updatrr for Shopify India: BYOK AI on every plan from ₹1,999/mo, a visitor pixel and a warranty hub vs USD tiers that gate AI at $99.99.
- [TopEdge vs Gupshup](https://topedgeai.com/compare/gupshup): Compare TopEdge AI vs Gupshup for Shopify India: self-serve ₹1,999/mo INR plans, 0% Meta markup and native COD journeys vs per-message enterprise CPaaS fees.

- [Best WATI Alternative for Shopify India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/wati-alternative-shopify-india): Looking for a WATI alternative for Shopify India? What to keep, what to fix (markup, AI access, COD), and how to test a switch in one afternoon.
- [Best AiSensy Alternative for Shopify India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/aisensy-alternative-shopify-india): Outgrowing AiSensy broadcasts on Shopify India? Compare 0% Meta markup (₹0.115 service vs ₹0.145 on AiSensy), BYOK AI, and native COD-to-prepaid flows.
- [Best Interakt Alternative for Shopify India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/interakt-alternative-shopify-india): An Interakt alternative for Shopify India: pricing from about ₹2,799, AI add-on cost, COD-to-prepaid on higher tiers, and a one-day switch test.
- [Best Bitespeed Alternative for Shopify India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/bitespeed-alternative-shopify-india): A Bitespeed alternative for Shopify India: revenue minimums, USD-style pricing and AI add-ons, versus a flat INR plan sized to your order volume.
- [WhatsApp Template Rejected? Fix It for Shopify](https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-template-rejected-meta-shopify-fix): Why Meta rejects WhatsApp templates for Shopify stores (category, variables, samples) and how to rewrite order, cart and COD templates for approval.
- [WhatsApp Opt-In for Shopify India: Checkout, Popups & DPDP](https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-opt-in-shopify-india): How to collect WhatsApp opt-in on Shopify in India: checkout, popups, QR and chat, what to record, and how to keep your quality rating healthy.
- [Ecommerce Profit Margins in India 2026: CAC, RTO & COD](https://topedgeai.com/blog/profitable-ecommerce-business-india): What ecommerce profit margins in India actually look like in 2026, what it costs to start, and how to protect margin against RTO, CAC and shipping.
- [How to Automate Your Shopify Store in India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/how-to-automate-ecommerce-store-india): A step-by-step guide to ecommerce automation for Indian store owners: order processing, inventory, support, WhatsApp and email workflows, and the tool stack.
- [Turn Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts into Ecommerce Leads](https://topedgeai.com/blog/organic-ecommerce-leads-short-form-video): How to turn Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts into trackable ecommerce leads in 2026: hooks, posting cadence, comment-to-DM capture, UTMs and follow-up.
- [Top 5 Product Categories to Sell Online in India 2026](https://topedgeai.com/blog/trending-products-to-sell-online-india-2026): The five highest-demand ecommerce categories for 2026 with realistic margins: smart home, eco-friendly, health and wellness, pet care and athleisure.
- [COD & RTO in Indian D2C: 2026 Benchmark & ₹ Cost Per Order](https://topedgeai.com/blog/cod-rto-benchmark-india-2026): 2026 India D2C RTO benchmark across 410M+ shipments: 39.2% festive peak vs 21.0% verified, 58% COD return rate, and ₹180 to ₹240 logistics loss math.
- [Organic vs Paid Ecommerce Marketing in India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/organic-vs-paid-ecommerce-marketing-2026): Phased ecommerce playbook: validate without ad spend, build organic momentum, deploy paid ads, and recover lost sales with TopEdge AI WhatsApp automation.
- [Best WhatsApp Apps for Shopify in 2026](https://topedgeai.com/blog/best-whatsapp-apps-for-shopify): Best WhatsApp apps for Shopify 2026, ranked by job. TopEdge AI leads on D2C depth at 0% Meta markup, then Getgabs, Zoko, AiSensy, Interakt, WATI.
- [Best Dondy Alternative for Shopify India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/dondy-alternative-shopify-india): Dondy’s WhatsApp rate table sits ~60% above Meta marketing rates. When that math matters for Shopify India: and when Dondy’s toolkit still fits.
- [WhatsApp Automation for Shopify India: Complete Guide](https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-automation-for-shopify): WhatsApp automation for Shopify: store events to journeys, lifecycle workflows, App vs Cloud API, opt-in, India COD, and cost.
- [Best Zoko Alternative for Shopify India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/zoko-alternative-shopify-india): Why Shopify India teams look for a Zoko alternative, what to require in a replacement (COD, templates, Meta billing) and how to test a switch in a day.
- [Best Getgabs Alternative for Shopify India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/getgabs-alternative-shopify-whatsapp): Getgabs wins on entry price. When Shopify India teams outgrow free-to-install WhatsApp apps: and how to judge depth without a price fight.
- [Best Kanal Alternative for Shopify India: INR vs EUR](https://topedgeai.com/blog/kanal-whatsapp-alternative-shopify): Kanal is strong for global WhatsApp + Klaviyo stacks. When India COD and INR pricing matter more than an EUR floor, here is how to evaluate alternatives.
- [How to Choose a WhatsApp App on Shopify App Store](https://topedgeai.com/blog/how-to-choose-whatsapp-app-shopify-app-store): Pre-install checklist: Meta markup, COD depth, conversation metering vs flat pricing, free-to-install vs gated features, and reviews that matter.
- [WhatsApp Business API Pricing India 2026: ₹ Rates & Fees](https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-business-api-pricing-india): Meta WhatsApp API rates in India from 1 October 2026: ₹0.8631 marketing, ₹0.115 utility, and ₹0.115 service replies after 1,000 free, plus BSP markup math.
- [AI WhatsApp Chatbot for Shopify India](https://topedgeai.com/blog/ai-whatsapp-chatbot-for-shopify-india): What a good AI WhatsApp chatbot for Shopify looks like in India: live SKUs, ₹ prices, COD FAQs, Meta-safe behavior, and clean handoff to humans.
- [What Is Ecommerce Automation on Shopify WhatsApp?](https://topedgeai.com/blog/what-is-ecommerce-automation-shopify-whatsapp): Plain definition of ecommerce automation on Shopify WhatsApp: carts, COD, order updates, campaigns, inbox, and what to automate first in India.
- [How to Reduce COD RTO on Shopify India: WhatsApp SOP](https://topedgeai.com/blog/how-to-reduce-rto-with-whatsapp-cod-confirmation): A step-by-step SOP to cut Shopify India RTO: utility template timing, confirm, reschedule and cancel branches, warehouse hold rules and what finance measures.
- [Best WhatsApp Automation for Shopify India (2026)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/best-whatsapp-automation-tools-shopify-india): Direct answer plus a comparison table of WhatsApp automation tools for Shopify India: WATI, AiSensy, Interakt, Bitespeed, Zoko, Getgabs, Kanal, Dondy, TopEdge.
- [Shopify WhatsApp Automation Go-Live Checklist (India)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/shopify-automation-checklist-whatsapp-cart-recovery): A fast Shopify automation checklist to connect WhatsApp, approve Meta templates, publish cart recovery, turn on COD paths, and open a shared inbox.
- [WhatsApp Shared Inbox with Shopify Orders](https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-shared-inbox-shopify-order-context): Why ecommerce teams need a WhatsApp shared inbox with Shopify order context: assignment, AI handoff, tags, and Instagram in one place.
- [Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Templates for Shopify](https://topedgeai.com/blog/meta-whatsapp-cloud-api-shopify-templates): A plain-English guide to Meta WhatsApp Cloud API templates for Shopify ecommerce: categories, approval tips, journey gating, and transparent rates.
- [WhatsApp vs Email Marketing Automation for D2C India](https://topedgeai.com/blog/ecommerce-automation-whatsapp-vs-email-india): Compare WhatsApp ecommerce automation vs email for cart recovery, order updates, and campaigns: when to use each channel on Shopify in India.
- [Shopify WhatsApp Automation: What to Automate First](https://topedgeai.com/blog/shopify-whatsapp-automation-what-to-automate-first): Prioritize Shopify WhatsApp automation that pays: abandoned cart, COD confirmation, order updates, then campaigns: a rollout order for Indian D2C ecommerce.
- [Shopify Abandoned Cart Recovery on WhatsApp (India)](https://topedgeai.com/blog/whatsapp-abandoned-cart-recovery-shopify): WhatsApp abandoned cart recovery for Shopify: cart vs checkout, message timing, templates, opt-in rules and what to look for in a recovery tool.
